content: extremely fast-paced, cinematic, bright, photorealistic FPV flight through the ancient Byzantine Empire at its magnificent peak. Begin soaring high above Constantinople at golden sunrise, then dive rapidly toward the colossal Theodosian Walls, skim above bustling streets filled with Byzantine citizens, merchants, soldiers, horses, and colorful market stalls, race between monumental stone buildings and marble columns, sweep through the vast Hippodrome packed with spectators and chariot racers, fly past imperial guards in historically authentic armor, then accelerate toward the magnificent Hagia Sophia with its enormous dome gleaming in sunlight. Continue over grand imperial palaces, churches, courtyards, harbors crowded with wooden Byzantine ships, and the sparkling Bosporus before climbing dramatically above Constantinople to reveal the immense ancient city stretching toward the horizon. Continuer au-dessus des grands palais impériaux, des églises, des cours, des ports encombrés de navires byzantins en bois, et du Bosphore étincelant avant de s’élever de façon spectaculaire au-dessus de Constantinople pour révéler l’immense cité antique s’étendant jusqu’à l’horizon.
